questions.question: If f(x) = 4x + 3, what is the inverse function f⁻¹(x)?
questions.explanation: To invert, undo the operations in reverse order. Start from y = 4x + 3, swap and solve: x = (y - 3)/4, so f⁻¹(x) = (x - 3)/4. Check it: f(f⁻¹(x)) = x. The reciprocal 1/(4x + 3) is not the inverse.
